race.description: Lather Up @ Woodlands Stud Mbl Pace
race.comment: SNOWIEWILLREV (5) made it two wins from his last four appearances two weeks ago, getting home by 13 metres over 2090m at this track. Big chance in a similar assignment. REMMINGTON (8) is on the radar after his last-start fifth over 1609m at this track nine days ago. MR BONDI NZ (4) showed pleasing improvement last time out when runner-up over 1609m at this track. IMPERIAL LAZ NZ (6) never fired here last start when finishing last of eight over 1609m when well fancied. He has won all of his seven career wins at this track and is worth another chance.
